# ============================================================
# Fig 2B - circos
# ============================================================

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Libraries
# ============================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(reshape2)
  library(circlize)
})

# ============================================================
# 0) Load lesion object and harmonise metadata
# ============================================================
seu <- readRDS("/Volumes/T7/Sam Gamble/PID/Code_revisions/July_2025/RDS/PBMC_CD4_SG_clustering_names_110925.rds")
lesion <- readRDS("/Volumes/T7/Sam Gamble/PID/Code_revisions/July_2025/RDS/newTcells_newPID_version1-TS260825.rds")

md <- lesion@meta.data |>
  mutate(
    seq_folder1 = case_when(
      seq_folder %in% c("P157_CIS_LT1", "P157_CIS_LT2") ~ "P157_CIS_LT_TP1",
      seq_folder == "P157_LTCIS" ~ "P157_CIS_LT_TP2",
      seq_folder %in% c("P155_Normal", "P155_NormRep") ~ "P155_Normal",
      TRUE ~ seq_folder
    ),
    final_pathology = if_else(
      seq_folder1 %in% c(
        "P149_CIS", "P152_CIS", "P153_CIS",
        "P157_CIS_LT_TP1", "P157_CIS_LT_TP2",
        "P704_RIB_CIS", "P158_RIB_POST_CIS",
        "P158_RUL_CAR_CIS", "P158_RUL_ORI_CIS",
        "P159_TR_Abnorm"
      ),
      "CIS", "Normal"
    )
  )

lesion@meta.data <- md

# ============================================================
# 1) Subset lesion to desired samples only
# ============================================================
cells_to_keep <- lesion@meta.data %>%
  filter(!seq_folder %in% c("P153_CIS", "P153_Normal", "P157_MTCIS")) %>%  # remove these samples
  pull(cells)

lesion <- subset(lesion, cells = cells_to_keep)

# ============================================================
# 2) Build unified clonotype dataframe: PBMC + lesion
# ============================================================

# --- PBMC arm (from `seu`) ---
pbmc_df <- seu@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    final.cell.types = case_when(
      final.cell.types == "BATF Treg" ~ "Effector Treg",
      final.cell.types == "ISG CD4"   ~ "Naive-like CD4",
      TRUE                            ~ final.cell.types
    )
  ) %>%
  select(seq_folder, final.cell.types, cdr3) %>%
  filter(seq_folder != "P151_PBMC") %>%     # exclude this PBMC sample
  drop_na(cdr3) %>%
  mutate(
    loc     = "PBMC",
    sample  = gsub("_PBMC", "", seq_folder),
    patient = gsub("_T1|_T2", "", sample)
  )

# --- lesion arm ---
lesion_df <- lesion@meta.data %>%
  # Explicitly call dplyr and rename during the select
  dplyr::select(seq_folder1, final.cell.types = cell.types, cdr3) %>%
  drop_na(cdr3) %>%
  mutate(loc = "lesion") %>%
  filter(seq_folder1 %in% c(
    "P157_CIS_LT_TP1", "P157_CIS_LT_TP2",
    "P158_RIB_POST_CIS", "P158_RUL_CAR_CIS", "P158_RUL_ORI_CIS",
    "P159_TR_Abnorm", "P704_RIB_CIS"
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    sample = case_when(
      seq_folder1 %in% c("P158_RIB_POST_CIS","P158_RUL_CAR_CIS","P158_RUL_ORI_CIS") ~ "P158_T1",
      seq_folder1 == "P157_CIS_LT_TP2" ~ "P157_T2",
      seq_folder1 == "P157_CIS_LT_TP1" ~ "P157_T1",
      seq_folder1 == "P159_TR_Abnorm"  ~ "P159",
      seq_folder1 == "P704_RIB_CIS"    ~ "P704",
      TRUE ~ seq_folder1
    ),
    patient = gsub("_T1|_T2", "", sample),
    seq_folder = seq_folder1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(seq_folder, final.cell.types, cdr3, loc, sample, patient)

# --- combine ---
data <- bind_rows(pbmc_df, lesion_df)

# ============================================================
# 3) Create a clonotype-by-sector matrix for CD4/Treg only
# ============================================================
df_tmp <- data %>%
  select(cdr3, loc, final.cell.types) %>%
  filter(grepl("CD4|Treg", final.cell.types)) %>%
  group_by(cdr3, loc, final.cell.types) %>%
  summarise(n_cdr3 = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cell.types_loc = paste0(final.cell.types, "_", loc)) %>%
  select(cdr3, cell.types_loc, n_cdr3) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cell.types_loc, values_from = n_cdr3, values_fill = 0)

cell_types <- colnames(df_tmp)[-1]

# ============================================================
# 4) Compute "shared" counts
# ============================================================
chord_list <- vector("list", length(cell_types))
names(chord_list) <- cell_types

for (current_cell_type in cell_types) {
  
  # Keep only clonotypes present in this source sector
  total_current_ct <- df_tmp %>%
    filter(.data[[current_cell_type]] > 0) %>%
    # Use pivot_longer instead of melt
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(cdr3, all_of(current_cell_type)), 
      names_to = "to", 
      values_to = "target_count"
    ) %>%
    filter(target_count > 0) %>%
    group_by(to) %>%
    summarise(
      total_current = sum(.data[[current_cell_type]]),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  chord_list[[current_cell_type]] <- total_current_ct
  message("Processed source sector: ", current_cell_type)
}

# --- symmetric merge ---
chord_df_shared <- bind_rows(chord_list, .id = "from") %>%
  mutate(
    from = as.character(from),
    to   = as.character(to),
    a = pmin(from, to),
    b = pmax(from, to)
  ) %>%
  group_by(from = a, to = b) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(total_current), .groups = "drop")

# ============================================================
# 5) Compute "unshared" counts per sector
# ============================================================
a <- data %>%
  filter(grepl("CD4|Treg", final.cell.types)) %>%
  drop_na(cdr3) %>%
  group_by(cdr3, final.cell.types, loc, sample) %>%
  summarise(n_cdr3 = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cell.types_loc = paste0(final.cell.types, "_", loc)) %>%
  # Keep only the columns we need for the pivot to avoid extra ID columns
  select(cdr3, sample, cell.types_loc, n_cdr3) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = cell.types_loc, values_from = n_cdr3, values_fill = 0)

# Now total_shared will only look at the numeric count columns
a <- a %>%
  mutate(total_shared = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(cdr3, sample, total_shared),
    names_to = "cell.types_loc",
    values_to = "n_cdr3"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_cdr3 > 0)

# Mark unshared clonotypes
unshared_all_df <- a %>%
  mutate(is_unshared = total_shared == 1) %>%
  filter(is_unshared) %>%
  separate(cell.types_loc, into = c("final.cell.types", "loc"), sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)") %>%
  group_by(final.cell.types, loc) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(n_cdr3), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(from = paste0(final.cell.types, "_", loc),
         to   = from) %>%
  select(from, to, value)

unshared_all_df <- unshared_all_df %>% mutate(value = value / 2)

# ============================================================
# 6) Combine shared + unshared into final chord dataframe
# ============================================================
chord_df2 <- bind_rows(
  chord_df_shared %>% select(from, to, value),
  unshared_all_df  %>% select(from, to, value)
) %>%
  mutate(across(c(from, to), as.character)) %>%
  mutate(value = replace_na(value, 0))

# ============================================================
# 7) Scale PBMC links down
# ============================================================
chord_df_plot <- chord_df2 %>%
  mutate(
    value = if_else(grepl("_PBMC$", from), value / 10, value)
  )

# ============================================================
# 8) Sector ordering + gaps by compartment
# ============================================================
get_comp <- function(x) sub(".*_(lesion|PBMC)$", "\\1", x)

sectors <- unique(c(chord_df_plot$from, chord_df_plot$to))
compartment <- get_comp(sectors)

sector_order <- sectors[order(factor(compartment, levels = c("lesion", "PBMC")), sectors)]
grp_ord <- get_comp(sector_order)

small_gap <- 2
big_gap   <- 12
last_in_group <- c(which(grp_ord[-length(grp_ord)] != grp_ord[-1]), length(grp_ord))
gap_after <- rep(small_gap, length(sector_order))
gap_after[last_in_group] <- big_gap

# ============================================================
# 9) Colours
# ============================================================
comp_cols <- c(lesion = "#4E79A7", PBMC = "#59A14F")
grid.col  <- setNames(comp_cols[grp_ord], sector_order)
stopifnot(identical(names(grid.col), sector_order))

all_sectors <- unique(c(chord_df_plot$from, chord_df_plot$to))

# default grey ribbons, override specific sources
src_palette <- setNames(rep("gray70", length(all_sectors)), all_sectors)
src_palette[c("BATF Treg_lesion", "Effector Treg_PBMC")] <- "firebrick"

# row-aligned colour vector, one entry per row in chord_df_plot
link_col <- unname(as.character(src_palette[match(chord_df_plot$from, names(src_palette))]))
stopifnot(length(link_col) == nrow(chord_df_plot), !any(is.na(link_col)))

# ============================================================
# 10) Plot to PDF
# ============================================================
out_pdf <- "/Users/Petros/Downloads/all_comps_circos_plot_grey_x10scale_updated.pdf"
pdf(out_pdf, width = 8, height = 8)

circos.clear()
circos.par(start.degree = 90, gap.after = gap_after, track.margin = c(0.01, 0.01))

chordDiagram(
  x = chord_df_plot,
  order = sector_order,
  grid.col = grid.col,       
  col = link_col,            
  transparency = 0.15,
  annotationTrack = "grid",
  preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.06)
)

# sector labels
circos.trackPlotRegion(
  track.index = 1,
  panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    circos.text(
      get.cell.meta.data("xcenter"),
      get.cell.meta.data("ylim")[2] + mm_y(1.5),
      labels = get.cell.meta.data("sector.index"),
      facing = "clockwise",
      niceFacing = TRUE,
      adj = c(0, 0.5),
      cex = 0.55
    )
  },
  bg.border = NA
)

legend("topleft", legend = names(comp_cols), fill = comp_cols, bty = "n", title = "Compartment")
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("BATF Treg_lesion (source)", "Effector Treg_PBMC (source)", "Others"),
  fill   = c("firebrick", "firebrick", "gray70"),
  bty = "n",
  title = "Ribbons (by source)"
)

dev.off()
message("Saved: ", out_pdf)

```

```{r}
                                "P159_TR_Abnorm", "P704_RIB_CIS")) %>%

                                           ifelse(seq_folder1 == "P159_TR_Abnorm", "P159", "P704")))),
             patient = gsub("_T1|_T2", "", sample)) %>% 
      dplyr::rename(seq_folder = seq_folder1)
  )


# export the cdr3s & look at sharing
join_cdr3s <- data %>% 
  select(sample, loc, cdr3, final.cell.types) %>% 
  drop_na(cdr3) %>% 
  filter(grepl("CD4|Treg", final.cell.types)) %>% 
  group_by(cdr3, final.cell.types, sample, loc) %>% 
  summarise(n_cdr3 = n()) %>% 
  mutate(cell.types_loc = paste0(final.cell.types, "_", loc)) %>% 
  reshape2::dcast(cdr3 + sample ~ cell.types_loc, value.var = "n_cdr3") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(`BATF Treg_lesion`))
join_cdr3s[is.na(join_cdr3s)] <- 0
join_cdr3s <- join_cdr3s %>% 
  mutate(total_shared = rowSums(across(`BATF Treg_lesion`:last_col())))

join_cdr3s1 <- join_cdr3s %>% 
  reshape2::melt(id.vars = c("cdr3", "sample", "total_shared"), value.name = "n_cdr3") %>%  
  separate(variable, into = c("final.cell.types", "loc"), sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)") %>% 
  filter(n_cdr3 > 0) %>% 
  mutate(batf_unshared = ifelse(final.cell.types == "BATF Treg" & loc == "lesion" & total_shared == 1, "Batf unshared", NA),
         new_n_cdr3 = ifelse(final.cell.types == "BATF Treg" & loc == "lesion", n_cdr3 - 1, n_cdr3))

# get unshared 
batf_unshared <- join_cdr3s1 %>% 
  filter(!is.na(batf_unshared)) %>% 
  group_by(loc) %>% 
  summarise(n = sum(n_cdr3)) 

shared <- join_cdr3s1 %>% 
  filter(is.na(batf_unshared)) %>% 
  group_by(loc) %>% 
  summarise(n = sum(n_cdr3)) %>% 
  rbind(batf_unshared %>% 
          mutate(loc = "unshared")) %>%
  mutate(prop_shared = n / sum(n))

if(sum(shared$n) == sum(join_cdr3s$total_shared)) {
  print("All cells maintained")
} else {
  print("Warning check through")
}

# what about cell types & getting significance?
shared_cell_types <- join_cdr3s1 %>% 
  filter(is.na(batf_unshared)) %>% 
  group_by(loc, final.cell.types, sample) %>% 
  summarise(n = sum(n_cdr3)) %>% 
  group_by(loc, sample) %>% 
  mutate(prop_shared = n / sum(n))

shared_cell_types1 <- shared_cell_types %>% 
  group_by(loc,final.cell.types) %>% 
  summarise(total_cells = sum(n)) %>% 
  group_by(loc) %>% 
  mutate(prop_shared = total_cells / sum(total_cells))




# instead of combining all together, can we try and plot this by patient/sample instead?
shared_cell_types1 <- shared_cell_types %>% 
  group_by(loc, final.cell.types) %>% 
  summarise(mean_shared = mean(prop_shared),
            sd = sd(prop_shared),
            n=n(),
            se = sd/sqrt(n)) %>% 
  group_by(loc) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_norm = mean_shared / sum(mean_shared) * 100,
    se_norm   = se / sum(mean_shared) * 100,  # scale SE the same way
    cs = cumsum(mean_norm)
  )
shared_ct_list <- split(shared_cell_types1, shared_cell_types1$loc)


library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
eps <- 1e-4  # small offset so logit is defined

run_target_mixed_model <- function(df, loc_use, target_types) {
  
  df1 <- df %>%
    filter(loc == loc_use) %>%
    mutate(
      p = pmin(pmax(prop_shared, eps), 1 - eps),
      logit_p = log(p / (1 - p)),
      is_target = final.cell.types %in% target_types
    )
  
  fit <- lmer(logit_p ~ is_target + (1 | sample), data = df1)
  
  # Estimated marginal means and contrast on logit scale
  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ is_target)
  ctr <- contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise")  # target TRUE vs FALSE
  
  # Back-transform (approx) to probabilities for reporting
  emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm) %>%
    mutate(
      est_prob = plogis(emmean),
      lower_prob = plogis(emmean - 1.96 * SE),
      upper_prob = plogis(emmean + 1.96 * SE)
    )
  
  list(
    data = df1,
    fit = fit,
    emmeans = emm_df,
    contrast = as.data.frame(ctr)
  )
}

# Lesion: BATF Treg + Progenitor vs all others
res_lesion <- run_target_mixed_model(
  df = shared_cell_types,
  loc_use = "lesion",
  target_types = c("BATF Treg", "Progenitor CD4")
)

res_lesion$emmeans
res_lesion$contrast

# PBMC: Effector Treg vs all others

)

res_pbmc$emmeans
res_pbmc$contrast




fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("p = NA")
  if (p < 0.001) return("p < 0.001")
  paste0("p = ", number(p, accuracy = 0.001))
}

p_lesion <- res_lesion$contrast$p.value[1]
p_pbmc   <- res_pbmc$contrast$p.value[1]

lab_lesion <- paste0("BATF Treg + Progenitor vs others: ", fmt_p(p_lesion))
lab_pbmc   <- paste0("Effector Treg vs others: ", fmt_p(p_pbmc))

for(i in seq_along(shared_ct_list)) {
  
  tmp_df <- shared_ct_list[[i]]
  loc_i  <- names(shared_ct_list)[i]
  
  if(loc_i == "lesion") {
    cell_type_levels <- c("BATF Treg", "Progenitor CD4", "Tcm-like Treg", "Tfh CD4", "Th17 CD4")
    ann_lab <- lab_lesion
  } else {
    cell_type_levels <- c("Effector Treg","Tcm-like Treg", "Tem CD4", "Tm CD4")
    ann_lab <- lab_pbmc
  }
  
  tmp_df <- tmp_df %>%
    mutate(final.cell.types = factor(final.cell.types, levels = rev(cell_type_levels)))
  
  p <- ggplot(data = tmp_df, aes(y = loc, x = mean_norm)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = final.cell.types), color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = cs - se_norm, xmax = cs + se_norm), color = "black", width = 0.3) +
    annotate("text",
             x = 50,
             y = loc_i,
             label = ann_lab,
             size = 5,
             vjust = -12) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.position = "right",
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 30, 10, 10)
    ) +
    labs(x = "Proportion of shared cells") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Tcm-like Treg" = "lightseagreen",
      "Th17 CD4" = "navajowhite4",
      "Effector Treg" = "firebrick",
      "Naive-like CD4" = "royalblue4",
      "Tm CD4" = "darkgoldenrod1",
      "Tcm CD4" = "olivedrab",
      "Tem CD4" = "burlywood",
      "Temra CD4" = "plum1",
      "BATF Treg" = "firebrick",
      "Progenitor CD4" = "royalblue4",
      "Tfh CD4" = "plum2"
    )) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))
  
  print(p)
  #ggsave(paste0("plots/Lesion_PBMC_sharing_wBATF_patient_TP_celltypes_", names(shared_ct_list)[i], "_errorbars.pdf"), 
  #dpi=320, width=6, height=2.5)
}
```

```{r}
# perform a DGE between BATF Treg uniques, shared with naive/progenitor, and then sharing with the blood
batf_private <- join_cdr3s %>% 
  mutate(batf_private = rowSums(across(`Effector Treg_PBMC`:`Tm CD4_PBMC`))) %>% 
  filter(batf_private == 0) %>% 
  select(cdr3, sample)

batf_naive <- join_cdr3s %>% 
  filter(`Progenitor CD4_lesion` > 0) %>% 
  select(cdr3, sample)

batf_blood <- join_cdr3s %>% 
  filter(`Progenitor CD4_lesion` == 0) %>% 
  filter(`Effector Treg_PBMC` > 0 | `Naive-like CD4_PBMC` > 0 | `Tcm CD4_PBMC` > 0 |
            `Tcm-like Treg_PBMC` > 0  | `Tem CD4_PBMC` > 0 | `Th17 CD4_PBMC` > 0  |  `Tm CD4_PBMC` > 0) %>% 
  select(cdr3, sample)

batf_tern <- rbind(
  batf_private %>% 
    mutate(group = "private"),
  batf_naive %>% 
    mutate(group = "naive"),
  batf_blood %>% 
    mutate(group = "blood")
) 

# subset the blood and lesion objects
lesion_cells <- lesion@meta.data %>% 
  mutate(sample = ifelse(seq_folder1 %in% c("P158_RIB_POST_CIS", "P158_RUL_CAR_CIS", "P158_RUL_ORI_CIS"), "P158_T1",
                         ifelse(seq_folder1 == "P157_CIS_LT_TP2", "P157_T2",
                                ifelse(seq_folder1 == "P157_CIS_LT_TP1", "P157_T1",
                                       ifelse(seq_folder1 == "P159_TR_Abnorm", "P159", "P704")))),
         patient = gsub("_T1|_T2", "", sample)) %>% 
  left_join(batf_tern, by = c("cdr3","sample")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(group) & cell.types == "BATF Treg") 

lesion_sub <- subset(lesion, cells = lesion_cells$cells)

row.names(lesion_cells) <- lesion_cells$cells
lesion_sub@meta.data <- lesion_cells

saveRDS(lesion_sub, "RDS/BATF_lesPBMC_seurat.rds")
lesion_sub <- readRDS("RDS/BATF_lesPBMC_seurat.rds")

# maybe just use the lesion cells. are we going to get anything?
DefaultAssay(lesion_sub) <- "RNA"

counts <- as.matrix(lesion_sub@assays$RNA@counts)

metadata <- lesion_sub@meta.data 

# Create single cell experiment object
sce <- SingleCellExperiment::SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = counts), colData = metadata)

# Identify groups for aggregation of counts
library(SingleCellExperiment)
colData(sce) <- colData(sce) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(
    group = as.factor(group),
    sample = as.factor(sample)
  ) %>%
  DataFrame()
saveRDS(sce, "RDS/BATF_Treg_tern_sce.rds")

#psce <- glmGamPoi::pseudobulk(sce, group_by = vars(group, sample))
psce <- readRDS("RDS/BATF_Treg_tern_psce.rds")
psce = sce

group <- unique(colData(psce)$group)

pb_gene_sigs <- list()

library(edgeR)

for(i in 1:length(group)) {
  current_cell_type <- group[i]
  print(current_cell_type)
  
  colData(psce)$is_cct <- colData(psce)$group == current_cell_type
  
  design <- model.matrix(~0+ is_cct, data = colData(psce))
  
  y <- DGEList(counts = counts(psce), remove.zeros = TRUE)
  y <- calcNormFactors(y)
  y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
  fit <- glmQLFit(y, design)
  
  B_vs_O <- glmLRT(fit, contrast = makeContrasts(is_cctTRUE-is_cctFALSE, levels = design))
  res <- topTags(B_vs_O, n = nrow(y$counts))
  
  dat2 <- as.data.frame(res) %>% 
    mutate(genes = row.names(.))
  
  pb_gene_sigs[[as.character(current_cell_type)]] <- dat2
}

saveRDS(pb_gene_sigs, "RDS/Batf_Treg_lesPBMC_pb_sigs.rds")
pb_gene_sigs <- readRDS("RDS/Batf_Treg_lesPBMC_pb_sigs.rds")

library(ggtern)

pb_sigs <- bind_rows(pb_gene_sigs, .id = "group") %>% 
  filter(!grepl("^AC|^HB|^TRG|^TRA|^TRB|RIK|^IG", genes)) %>% 
  reshape2::dcast(genes ~ group, value.var = "logFC")

pb_sigs_norm <- pb_sigs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(exp(c_across(blood:private))),
    blood_prop = exp(blood) / total,
    naive_prop = exp(naive) / total,
    private_prop = exp(private) / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(
    bind_rows(pb_gene_sigs, .id = "group") %>% 
      filter(logFC > 0) %>% 
      filter(!grepl("^AC|^HB|^TRG|^TRA|^TRB|RIK|^IG", genes)) %>% 
      mutate(Significance = ifelse(group == "blood" & logFC > 0.35 & PValue < 0.05, "Enriched in Blood",
                                   ifelse(group == "naive" & logFC > 0.35 & PValue < 0.05, "Enriched in Naive",
                                          ifelse(group == "private" & logFC > 0.35 & PValue < 0.05, "Enriched in Private", NA)))) %>% 
      select(genes, Significance) %>% 
      drop_na(Significance) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = "genes"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(Significance = ifelse(is.na(Significance), "ns", Significance))

geneSig <- bind_rows(pb_gene_sigs, .id = "group") %>% 
  filter(logFC > 0 & PValue < 0.05) %>% 
  filter(!grepl("^AC|^HB|^TRG|^TRA|^TRB|RIK|^IG", genes)) %>% 
  filter(genes %in% c("KLF2", "KLF3", "LEF1", "STAT1", "S1PR1", "AREG", "CD86", "CCL20", "RUNX2",
                      "CXCL13", "HSPA6", "HLA-DQB2", "HLA-DPA1", "CCR6", "HLA-DQA1", "PDCD1", "IFNG",
                      "CCL4", "CXCR6", "IL10", "CCR8", "NKG7", "TNFRSF8", "IL2RA", "LAG3", "HAVCR2", "CXCL10", "GZMK"))
geneSig <- pb_sigs_norm %>% 
  mutate(label = ifelse(genes %in% geneSig$genes, genes, NA)) %>% 
  drop_na(label)


ggtern(data = pb_sigs_norm, aes(x = blood_prop, y = naive_prop, z = private_prop)) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha=Significance, size=Significance, fill=Significance), pch=21) +
  #geom_point(alpha=0.5, size=1) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("ns" = 0.15,"Enriched in Blood" = 0.4, "Enriched in Naive" = 0.4, "Enriched in Private" = 0.4)) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c("ns" = 0.5, "Enriched in Blood" = 3, "Enriched in Naive" = 3, "Enriched in Private" = 3)) +
  geom_text(data = geneSig, aes(label = genes, color=Significance), size = 5, fontface = "bold") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Enriched in Blood" = "#59A14F", "Enriched in Private" = "firebrick", "Enriched in Naive" =  "royalblue4")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("ns" = "gray50","Enriched in Blood" = "lightseagreen", "Enriched in Naive" = "royalblue1", "Enriched in Private" = "firebrick1")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Blood", 
    y = "Naive", 
    z = "Private"
  )
ggsave("plots/PBMC/BATF_Treg_les_ternary.pdf", dpi=320, width=13, height=13)
```

```{r}
sigs <- as.character(unique(batf_ucell1$signature))

for (i in sigs) {

    na.omit() %>% 
    mutate(group = row.names(.)) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(lower_ci = `2.5 %`,
                  upper_ci = `97.5 %`)
  
  results_df <- as.data.frame(summary(mod)$coefficients) %>% 
    mutate(group = row.names(.)) %>% 
    left_join(conf, by = "group")
  
  mem_mods[[i]] <- results_df
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# 1) Build plotting meta: join UMAP coords, harmonise labels, keep CD4/Treg only
md1 <- seu@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cells") %>%
  left_join(
    as.data.frame(Embeddings(seu, reduction = "umap")) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("cells") %>%
      dplyr::rename(UMAP_1 = UMAP_1, UMAP_2 = UMAP_2),
    by = "cells"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    final.cell.types = dplyr::case_when(
      final.cell.types == "BATF Treg" ~ "Effector Treg",
      final.cell.types == "ISG CD4"   ~ "Naive-like CD4",
      TRUE                            ~ final.cell.types
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(grepl("CD4|Treg", final.cell.types))

# 2) Random plotting order so dense classes don't systematically sit on top
set.seed(1)
md1_plot <- md1 %>% slice_sample(prop = 1)

# 3) Label positions: robust centroids (median)
centroids <- md1_plot %>%
  group_by(final.cell.types) %>%
  summarise(
    UMAP_1 = median(UMAP_1, na.rm = TRUE),
    UMAP_2 = median(UMAP_2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 4) Plot
p <- ggplot(md1_plot, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = final.cell.types),
    shape = 21,
    size = 4,       # match your "based on above" style
    alpha = 0.8,
    stroke = 0,
    colour = "transparent"
  ) +
  # geom_label_repel(
  #   data = centroids,
  #   aes(label = final.cell.types),
  #   max.overlaps = 20,
  #   size = 6
  # ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20)
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Tcm-like Treg"   = "lightseagreen",
    "Th17 CD4"        = "navajowhite4",
    "Effector Treg"   = "firebrick",
    "Naive-like CD4"  = "royalblue4",
    "Tm CD4"          = "darkgoldenrod1",
    "Tcm CD4"         = "olivedrab",
    "Tem CD4"         = "burlywood",
    "Tem CD8"         = "plum1"
  ))

ggsave(
  "plots/PBMC/CD4_UMAP_SG_cluster.pdf",
  plot = p,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

ggsave(
```

# ============================================================
# Fig 2G
# ============================================================
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)
library(Seurat)
library(UCell)
library(patchwork)
library(rstatix)
library(purrr)

# ----------------------------
# 0) BATF Treg signature from pseudobulk
# ----------------------------
pb_gene_sigs <- readRDS("C:/Users/andre/OneDrive - University College London/PhD Year 3/PID paper/Resubmission/July_2025/July_2025/RDS/pb_gene_sigs_Tcell.rds")
pb_gene_sigs <- pb_gene_sigs[c("Progenitor CD4", "Th17 CD4", "BATF Treg", "Tfh CD4", "Tcm-like Treg")]

gene.sig.list.pb <- vector("list", length(pb_gene_sigs))
names(gene.sig.list.pb) <- names(pb_gene_sigs)

for (i in seq_along(pb_gene_sigs)) {
  df_tmp <- pb_gene_sigs[[i]] |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    dplyr::filter(logFC > 0.25, PValue < 0.05) |>
    dplyr::filter(!grepl("^AC|CHAIN|^HIST|^HB|^TRA|^TRB|^IGH|^IGL|^IGK|^LINC", genes)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(logFC)) |>
    dplyr::rename(X = genes)
  
  df_tmp <- df_tmp[seq_len(min(300, nrow(df_tmp))), , drop = FALSE]
  gene.sig.list.pb[[i]] <- df_tmp
}

batf_treg_sig <- gene.sig.list.pb$`BATF Treg`$X
batf_treg_sig <- intersect(batf_treg_sig, rownames(seu))

# ----------------------------
# 1) Add UCell score
# ----------------------------
DefaultAssay(seu) <- "RNA"

seu <- AddModuleScore_UCell(
  seu,
  features = list(BATF_Treg_pb = batf_treg_sig),
  assay = "RNA",
  name = NULL
)

score_col <- "BATF_Treg_pb"

# ----------------------------
# 2) Gene panel
# ----------------------------
gene_sets <- list(
  "TIL Treg" = c(
    "FOXP3", "BATF", "CCR8", "IKZF2", "IL2RA",
    "CTLA4", "TNFRSF4", "TNFRSF9", "TNFRSF18", "ENTPD1"
  )
)

module_levels <- c("TIL Treg")

celltype_levels <- c(
  "Effector Treg",
  "Tcm-like Treg",
  "Th17 CD4",
  "Tem CD4",
  "Tm CD4",
  "Tcm CD4",
  "Naive-like CD4"
)

gene_levels <- c(
  "FOXP3", "BATF", "CCR8", "IKZF2", "IL2RA", "CTLA4",
  "TNFRSF4", "TNFRSF9", "TNFRSF18", "ENTPD1"
)

genes_df <- enframe(gene_sets, name = "module", value = "gene") |>
  unnest(gene) |>
  select(gene, module) |>
  mutate(module = factor(module, levels = module_levels))

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(gene_levels))

genes_present <- intersect(genes_df$gene, rownames(seu))
genes_missing <- setdiff(genes_df$gene, rownames(seu))

if (length(genes_missing) > 0) {
  message("Missing genes dropped: ", paste(genes_missing, collapse = ", "))
}

# choose your sample-level variable here
sample_var <- dplyr::case_when(
  "sample_id" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data) ~ "sample_id",
  "seq_folder" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data) ~ "seq_folder",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

if (is.na(sample_var)) {
  stop("Could not find a sample identifier column. Add one of: sample_id or seq_folder.")
}

df <- FetchData(
  object = seu,
  vars   = c("final.cell.types", sample_var, score_col, genes_present),
  layer  = "data"
) |>
  rownames_to_column("cell.id") |>
  mutate(
    final.cell.types = case_when(
      final.cell.types == "BATF Treg" ~ "Effector Treg",
      final.cell.types == "ISG CD4" ~ "Naive-like CD4",
      TRUE ~ final.cell.types
    )
  ) |>
  filter(final.cell.types %in% celltype_levels) |>
  rename(sample_id = all_of(sample_var))

# ----------------------------
# 3) Long format for dot plot
# ----------------------------
df_long <- df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(genes_present),
    names_to = "gene",
    values_to = "expr"
  )

summ <- df_long |>
  group_by(final.cell.types, gene) |>
  summarise(
    mean_expr = mean(expr),
    perc_expr = mean(expr > 0) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    genes_df |>
      filter(gene %in% genes_present),
    by = "gene"
  ) |>
  group_by(gene) |>
  mutate(scaled_mean_expr = as.numeric(scale(mean_expr))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    final.cell.types = factor(final.cell.types, levels = celltype_levels),
    module = factor(module, levels = module_levels),
    gene = factor(gene, levels = gene_levels)
  )

# ----------------------------
# 4) UCell summary for fill column
# ----------------------------
ucell_summ <- df |>
  group_by(final.cell.types) |>
  summarise(
    mean_ucell = mean(.data[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    final.cell.types = factor(final.cell.types, levels = celltype_levels),
    signature = factor("BATF+ Treg\nUCell score", levels = "BATF+ Treg\nUCell score"),
    scaled_ucell = as.numeric(scale(mean_ucell))
  )

# ----------------------------
# 5) Stats versus Naive-like CD4
# ----------------------------
ref_group <- "Naive-like CD4"

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "",
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

# 5a) sample-level test, compare per-sample mean scores
sample_means <- df |>
  group_by(sample_id, final.cell.types) |>
  summarise(
    mean_ucell = mean(.data[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sample_stats <- map_dfr(
  setdiff(celltype_levels, ref_group),
  function(ct) {
    dat_sub <- sample_means |>
      filter(final.cell.types %in% c(ct, ref_group))
    
    samp_counts <- dat_sub |>
      count(final.cell.types) |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = final.cell.types, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
    
    n_ct <- if (ct %in% colnames(samp_counts)) samp_counts[[ct]][1] else 0
    n_ref <- if (ref_group %in% colnames(samp_counts)) samp_counts[[ref_group]][1] else 0
    
    p_val <- if (n_ct >= 2 && n_ref >= 2) {
      wilcox.test(mean_ucell ~ final.cell.types, data = dat_sub)$p.value
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
    
    tibble(
      final.cell.types = ct,
      p = p_val,
      label = p_to_stars(p_val),
      stat_type = "Sample\nlevel"
    )
  }
)

sample_stats <- bind_rows(
  sample_stats,
  tibble(
    final.cell.types = ref_group,
    p = NA_real_,
    label = "",
    stat_type = "Sample\nlevel"
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    final.cell.types = factor(final.cell.types, levels = celltype_levels),
    stat_type = factor(stat_type, levels = "Sample\nlevel")
  )

# 5b) cell-level test, compare all cells directly
cell_stats <- map_dfr(
  setdiff(celltype_levels, ref_group),
  function(ct) {
    dat_sub <- df |>
      filter(final.cell.types %in% c(ct, ref_group))
    
    n_ct <- sum(dat_sub$final.cell.types == ct)
    n_ref <- sum(dat_sub$final.cell.types == ref_group)
    
    p_val <- if (n_ct >= 2 && n_ref >= 2) {
      wilcox.test(dat_sub[[score_col]] ~ dat_sub$final.cell.types)$p.value
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
    
    tibble(
      final.cell.types = ct,
      p = p_val,
      label = p_to_stars(p_val),
      stat_type = "Cell\nlevel"
    )
  }
)

cell_stats <- bind_rows(
  cell_stats,
  tibble(
    final.cell.types = ref_group,
    p = NA_real_,
    label = "",
    stat_type = "Cell\nlevel"
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    final.cell.types = factor(final.cell.types, levels = celltype_levels),
    stat_type = factor(stat_type, levels = "Cell\nlevel")
  )

stats_df <- bind_rows(sample_stats, cell_stats)

# optional multiple-testing correction within each stat type
stats_df <- stats_df |>
  group_by(stat_type) |>
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
    label = p_to_stars(p_adj)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# ----------------------------
# 6) Main dot plot
# ----------------------------
p_dot <- ggplot(summ, aes(x = gene, y = final.cell.types)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = scaled_mean_expr, size = perc_expr),
    shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "darkblue", "#6DCCFF", "lightblue2", "white",
      "lightgoldenrod2", "darkorange1", "red", "firebrick"
    ),
    values = scales::rescale(
      c(-1.8, -1.2, -0.6, 0, 0.6, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8),
      from = c(-1.8, 1.8)
    ),
    limits = c(-1.8, 1.8),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Scaled mean expression /\nUCell score"
  ) +
  scale_radius(range = c(1, 10), name = "% expressed") +
  facet_grid(~module, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey", linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black", angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black")
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)

# ----------------------------
# 7) UCell heatmap column
# ----------------------------
p_ucell <- ggplot(ucell_summ, aes(x = signature, y = final.cell.types, fill = scaled_ucell)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "darkblue", "#6DCCFF", "lightblue2", "white",
      "lightgoldenrod2", "darkorange1", "red", "firebrick"
    ),
    values = scales::rescale(
      c(-1.8, -1.2, -0.6, 0, 0.6, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8),
      from = c(-1.8, 1.8)
    ),
    limits = c(-1.8, 1.8),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Scaled mean expression /\nUCell score"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black", angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black")
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)

# ----------------------------
# 8) Stat columns
# ----------------------------
p_stats <- ggplot(stats_df, aes(x = stat_type, y = final.cell.types)) +
  geom_tile(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 9, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),

    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black", angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)

# ----------------------------
# 9) Combine
# ----------------------------
p_final <- p_dot + p_ucell + p_stats +
  plot_layout(widths = c(10, 1.2, 1.8), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_final

# inspect exact p values too
stats_df |>
  arrange(stat_type, final.cell.types)

ggsave("plots/Dotplot/Fig2G.pdf", plot = p_final, dpi = 320, width = 8, height = 6)
```

# ============================================================
# Fig 2N
# ============================================================
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ----------------------------
# 0) Paths and input
# ----------------------------
freq_file <- "E:/Sam Gamble/Flow cytometry clustering/PID/CD4 - CPM 107/107PID_CD4_cluster_freqs.csv"
meta_file <- "E:/Sam Gamble/PID/Files/PID_68_samples_231122.csv"

cd4_clus <- read.csv(
  freq_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

md <- read.csv(
  meta_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# ----------------------------
# 1) Long format sample-level table
# ----------------------------
freq_long <- cd4_clus |>
  rename(JR_code = 1) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -JR_code,
    names_to = "cluster_id",
    values_to = "freq"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    md |>
      select(JR_code, patient_id, lesion_grade),
    by = "JR_code"
  ) |>
  drop_na(patient_id, lesion_grade) |>
  filter(lesion_grade %in% c("low_grade", "high_grade")) |>
  mutate(
    lesion_grade = factor(lesion_grade, levels = c("low_grade", "high_grade")),
    patient_id = factor(patient_id)
  )

stopifnot(all(c("JR_code", "patient_id", "lesion_grade", "cluster_id", "freq") %in% colnames(freq_long)))

# ----------------------------
# 2) Aggregate to patient-level mean frequency
# ----------------------------
patient_cluster <- freq_long |>
  group_by(patient_id, lesion_grade, cluster_id) |>
  summarise(
    mean_freq_patient = mean(freq, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples_patient = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# 3) Effect size for x-axis
#    log2FC of mean patient-level frequency (HG / LG)
# ----------------------------
eps <- 1e-6

mean_props_patient <- patient_cluster |>
  group_by(lesion_grade, cluster_id) |>
  summarise(
    mean_freq = mean(mean_freq_patient, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = lesion_grade, values_from = mean_freq) |>
  mutate(
    log2FC = log2((high_grade + eps) / (low_grade + eps)),
    mean_cluster_frequency = (high_grade + low_grade) / 2
  )

# ----------------------------
# 4) Per-cluster patient-level tests
#    Primary: Wilcoxon
#    Optional: Welch t-test too
# ----------------------------
patient_tests <- patient_cluster |>
  group_by(cluster_id) |>
  summarise(
    p_value_wilcox = wilcox.test(mean_freq_patient ~ lesion_grade, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    p_value_t = t.test(mean_freq_patient ~ lesion_grade)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    fdr_wilcox = p.adjust(p_value_wilcox, method = "BH"),
    fdr_t = p.adjust(p_value_t, method = "BH")
  )

# choose which one to plot as primary
volcano_patient <- mean_props_patient |>
  left_join(patient_tests, by = "cluster_id") |>
  mutate(
    p_value = p_value_wilcox,
    fdr = fdr_wilcox,
    neglog10fdr = -log10(fdr),
    sig = case_when(
      fdr < 0.05 ~ "FDR < 0.05",
      fdr < 0.1  ~ "0.05 ≤ FDR < 0.1",
      TRUE       ~ "FDR ≥ 0.1"
    ),
    sig = factor(sig, levels = c("FDR < 0.05", "0.05 ≤ FDR < 0.1", "FDR ≥ 0.1"))
  )

# ----------------------------
# 5) Labels
# ----------------------------
label_tbl <- tibble(
  cluster_id = c(
    "CD4.NAIVE",
    "CD4.TCM.CD38lo",
    "CD4.TCM.CD38int",
    "CD4.TCM.prolif.HLA-DRlo",
    "CD4.TCM.prolif.HLA-DRhi",
    "CD4.TEM.CCR7int",
    "CD4.TEM.CD27lo",
    "CD4.TEM.CD27hi",
    "TREG.prolif",
    "TREG.CD39lo.CD38int",
    "TREG.CD39hi.CD38lo",
    "TREG.CD39hi.CD38int",
    "CD4.TEM.prolif",
    "CD4.TEX.prolif",
    "CD4.TEX",
    "Cytotoxic.TEMRA",
    "Cytotoxic"
  ),
  label_parsed = c(
    "Naive",
    '"Tcm"^"CD38lo"',
    '"Tcm"^"CD38int"',
    '"Tcm"^"prolifHLA-DRlo"',
    '"Tcm"^"prolifHLA-DRhi"',
    '"Tem"^"CCR7int"',
    '"Tem"^"CD27lo"',
    '"Tem"^"CD27hi"',
    '"Treg"^"prolif"',
    '"Treg"^"CD39loCD38int"',
    '"Treg"^"CD39hiCD38lo"',
    '"Treg"^"CD39hiCD38int"',
    '"Tem"^"prolif"',
    '"Tex"^"prolif"',
    "Tex",
    '"Cytotoxic"^"Temra"',
    "Cytotoxic"
  )
)

volcano_patient <- volcano_patient |>
  left_join(label_tbl, by = "cluster_id")

# ----------------------------
# 6) Plot, patient-level primary analysis
# ----------------------------
p_patient <- ggplot(volcano_patient, aes(x = log2FC, y = neglog10fdr)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = mean_cluster_frequency, fill = sig),
    shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.8, alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label_parsed),
    parse = TRUE,
    size = 7,
    max.overlaps = 30,
    force = 20,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.25,
    segment.color = "grey40",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "FDR < 0.05" = "firebrick",
      "0.05 ≤ FDR < 0.1" = "indianred",
      "FDR ≥ 0.1" = "black"
    )
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(4, 16)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.1, 0.1), linetype = "dashed", colour = "blue", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1), linetype = "dotted", colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 22),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.7),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Log2(FC) of mean patient-level cluster frequency (high-grade / low-grade)",
    y = expression(-Log[10]~"(FDR) [patient-level Wilcoxon]"),
    fill = "Significance",
    size = "Mean cluster\nfrequency"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(order = 1),
    size = guide_legend(order = 2)
  )

p_patient

ggsave("Fig2N.pdf", plot = p_patient, dpi = 320, width = 9, height = 7)

# ----------------------------
# 7) Output tables
# ----------------------------
volcano_patient |>
  arrange(fdr, p_value) |>
  select(cluster_id, label, log2FC, p_value, fdr, mean_cluster_frequency, sig) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(rio)
library(tibble)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

# sample-level data
treg_39mg <- rio::import("E:/Sam Gamble/PID/Files/PID_RAneg_39pos_foxpos_final_freqs.xlsx") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  dplyr::select(1:4) |>
  dplyr::rename(treg_39 = `CD45RA-FoxP3+CD39+`) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    patient_id = factor(patient_id),
    Grade = factor(Grade, levels = c("low", "high")),
    log10_treg_39 = log10(treg_39)
  )

# LME
mod_treg39 <- lmer(
  log10_treg_39 ~ Grade + (1 | patient_id),
  data = treg_39mg
)

emm_treg39 <- emmeans(mod_treg39, ~ Grade)

contrast_df <- summary(
  contrast(emm_treg39, method = list("high - low" = c(-1, 1)))
) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(
    p_one_sided = pt(t.ratio, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    p_label = paste0("LME, p = ", signif(p.value, 2))
  )

p_lab <- contrast_df$p_label[1]

ggplot(treg_39mg, aes(x = Grade, y = treg_39)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "white",
    colour = "black",
    alpha = 1,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    width = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(fill = Grade),
    width = 0.15,
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.9,
    shape = 21,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = 12.5,
    label = p_lab,
    size = 5
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 45, hjust = 1, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("low" = "dodgerblue3", "high" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(
    y = bquote("%" ~ Treg^"CD45RA"^"-" ~ ""^CD39^"+" ~ " of CD4")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0.8, 13),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03)),
    trans = "log10"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("low" = "Low", "high" = "High"))
```

# ============================================================
# Fig 2Q
# ============================================================
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(rio)
library(logistf)

# --- Helper: Robust P-Value Formatter ---
format_p_value <- function(p_value) {
  if (is.na(p_value)) return("") 
  if (p_value == 0) return("p = 0")
  if (p_value < 0.001) return(sprintf("p = %0.2e", p_value))
  return(sprintf("p = %0.3f", p_value))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. PID COHORT: DATA PREP & MVA
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
age <- rio::import("/Volumes/UCL_CI_HD1/CI/PhD/PID/Files/PID_107_ages.xlsx") %>% as_tibble()
pid107 <- rio::import("/Volumes/UCL_CI_HD1/CI/PhD/PID/Files/PID_107_samples_231122.xlsx") %>% as_tibble()
cd <- rio::import("/Volumes/UCL_CI_HD1/CI/PhD/PID/Files/PID_68_cancer_diagnosis_231122.xlsx") %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% dplyr::select(-any_of("JR_code")) %>% dplyr::rename(JR_code = JR_code1)

clinical_all <- cd[,c("patient_id", "JR_code", "cancer_before_any")] %>% 
  left_join(pid107 %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, JR_code, lesion_grade, Date, Sex_L4L, pack_years), by = c("patient_id", "JR_code")) %>% 
  left_join(age, by = c("patient_id", "Date")) %>% 
  mutate(lesion_grade = factor(lesion_grade, levels = c("low_grade", "high_grade")))

sex <- clinical_all[!duplicated(clinical_all$patient_id),] %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, Sex_L4L)
py <- clinical_all %>% group_by(patient_id) %>% arrange(desc(Date)) %>% dplyr::slice(1) %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, cancer_before_any)

treg_39mg <- rio::import("/Volumes/UCL_CI_HD1/CI/PhD/PID/Files/PID_RAneg_39pos_foxpos_final_freqs.xlsx") %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% dplyr::rename(treg_39_mg = `CD45RA-FoxP3+CD39+`)

treg_39mgp <- treg_39mg %>% group_by(patient_id) %>% summarise(treg_39_mg = mean(treg_39_mg, na.rm = TRUE))

pid_final_df <- clinical_all %>% 
  group_by(patient_id) %>% 
  summarise(pack_years_mean = mean(pack_years, na.rm = TRUE),
            age_mean = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
            lesion_grade = dplyr::first(lesion_grade)) %>% 
  full_join(sex, by = "patient_id") %>% 
  full_join(py, by = "patient_id") %>% 
  full_join(treg_39mgp, by = "patient_id") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(outcome = ifelse(lesion_grade == "low_grade", 0, 1)) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(outcome, treg_39_mg)

# SCALING STEP: Create a scaled version for the model
pid_final_df_scaled <- pid_final_df %>%
  mutate(across(c(treg_39_mg, pack_years_mean, age_mean), ~ as.numeric(scale(.))))

# Run Firth's MVA (PID)
pid_mg_mod <- logistf(outcome ~ treg_39_mg + pack_years_mean + cancer_before_any + age_mean, data = pid_final_df_scaled)

# Plot Prep
pid_plot_data <- data.frame(
  vars = names(pid_mg_mod$coefficients),
  Coefficient = exp(pid_mg_mod$coefficients),
  Lower_CI = exp(pid_mg_mod$ci.lower),
  Upper_CI = exp(pid_mg_mod$ci.upper),
  P_Value = pid_mg_mod$prob
) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(vars != "(Intercept)") %>% 
  mutate(rounded_p = sapply(P_Value, format_p_value),
         # Add rev() here:
         vars = factor(vars, levels = rev(c("treg_39_mg", "age_mean", "pack_years_mean", "cancer_before_anyY"))))

# Update 1: Add rev() to the factor levels
pid_plot_data <- data.frame(
  vars = names(pid_mg_mod$coefficients),
  Coefficient = exp(pid_mg_mod$coefficients),
  Lower_CI = exp(pid_mg_mod$ci.lower),
  Upper_CI = exp(pid_mg_mod$ci.upper),
  P_Value = pid_mg_mod$prob
) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(vars != "(Intercept)") %>% 
  mutate(rounded_p = sapply(P_Value, format_p_value),
         # Add rev() here:
         vars = factor(vars, levels = rev(c("treg_39_mg", "age_mean", "pack_years_mean", "cancer_before_anyY"))))

# Update 2: Use a named vector for scale_fill_manual
pid_forest_plot <- ggplot(pid_plot_data, aes(x=vars, y=as.numeric(Coefficient), fill = vars)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray67") +
  geom_pointrange(shape = 21, aes(ymin=as.numeric(Lower_CI), ymax = as.numeric(Upper_CI)), size = 2.5, color="black") +
  # Turn off clipping so labels don't get chopped
  coord_flip(clip = "off") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("treg_39_mg" = "gold", "age_mean" = "black", "pack_years_mean" = "navajowhite", "cancer_before_anyY" = "white")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("treg_39_mg" = bquote(Treg^"CD45RA"^"-"~""^"CD39"^"+"), 
                              "age_mean" = "Age (per SD)", 
                              "pack_years_mean" = "Pack years (per SD)", 
                              "cancer_before_anyY" = "Prior cancer")) +
  # ADDED LOG10 AND EXPANDED UPPER LIMIT FOR P-VALUES:
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.6))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Odds ratio (Standardized, log scale)", title = "High-grade lesion risk") +
  geom_text(aes(label = rounded_p, y = Inf), position = position_nudge(x = 0.4), size = 7, hjust = 1) + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 26, color="black"), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30), 
        plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face="bold", hjust=0.5), 
        legend.position = 'none',
        plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")) # Extra margin just in case

print(pid_forest_plot)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. ASCENT COHORT: DATA PREP & MVA
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
quad <- rio::import("/Volumes/UCL_CI_HD1/CI/PhD/ASCENT/Files/ASC_MG_RAneg_39pos_foxpos.xlsx") %>% as_tibble()
controls <- rio::import("/Volumes/UCL_CI_HD1/CI/PhD/ASCENT/TCR/Files/controls_demographics.xlsx") %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, `Age of patient at sample collection`, `Biological Sex`, smoking_status) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Age = `Age of patient at sample collection`, Gender = `Biological Sex`)

md_ascent <- rio::import("/Volumes/UCL_CI_HD1/CI/PhD/ASCENT/Files/ASCENT_clinical_300623_flow.xlsx") %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, Age, Gender, `Smoking status`) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(smoking_status = `Smoking status`) %>% rbind(controls)

treg_mva_asc <- quad %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Diagnosis != "Benign") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(treg_39_mg = `CD45RA-FoxP3+CD39+`) %>% 
  left_join(md_ascent, by = "patient_id") %>% 
  mutate(outcome = ifelse(Diagnosis == "Healthy", 0, 1),
         smoking_binary = factor(ifelse(smoking_status %in% c("never", "unknown", "non-smoker"), "Never", "Ever"), levels = c("Never", "Ever"))) %>% 
  na.omit()

# SCALING STEP: Create a scaled version for the model
treg_mva_asc_scaled <- treg_mva_asc %>%
  mutate(across(c(treg_39_mg, Age), ~ as.numeric(scale(.))))

asc_mg_mod <- logistf(outcome ~ treg_39_mg + Age + Gender + smoking_binary, data = treg_mva_asc_scaled)

asc_plot_data <- data.frame(
  vars = names(asc_mg_mod$coefficients),
  Coefficient = exp(asc_mg_mod$coefficients),
  Lower_CI = exp(asc_mg_mod$ci.lower),
  Upper_CI = exp(asc_mg_mod$ci.upper),
  P_Value = asc_mg_mod$prob
) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(vars != "(Intercept)") %>% 
  mutate(rounded_p = sapply(P_Value, format_p_value),
         # Add rev() here:
         vars = factor(vars, levels = rev(c("treg_39_mg", "Age", "GenderMale", "smoking_binaryEver"))))

# Plot Fig S5D 
asc_forest_plot <- ggplot(asc_plot_data, aes(x=vars, y=as.numeric(Coefficient), fill = vars)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray67") +
  geom_pointrange(shape = 21, aes(ymin=as.numeric(Lower_CI), ymax = as.numeric(Upper_CI)), size = 2.5, color="black") +
  # Turn off clipping
  coord_flip(clip = "off") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("treg_39_mg" = "white", "Age" = "gold", "GenderMale" = "dodgerblue3", "smoking_binaryEver" = "black")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("treg_39_mg" = bquote("Treg"^"CD45RA"^"-"~""^"CD39"^"+"), 
                              "Age" = "Age (per SD)", 
                              "GenderMale" = "Male", 
                              "smoking_binaryEver" = "Ever Smoker")) +
  # EXPANDED UPPER LIMIT FOR P-VALUES:
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.6))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Odds ratio (Standardized, log scale)", title = "NSCLC risk") +
  geom_text(aes(label = rounded_p, y = Inf), position = position_nudge(x = 0.4), size = 7, hjust = 1) + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 26, color="black"), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30), 
        plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face="bold", hjust=0.5), 
        legend.position = 'none',
        plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm"))

print(asc_forest_plot)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. REVISED BOX-WHISKER PLOTS (COVARIATE-CENTRIC)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Y-Axis Label
treg_lab <- bquote("Treg"^"CD45RA"^"-"~""^"CD39"^"+"~"of CD4")

# --- 3A. Prepare Categorical Versions of Continuous Vars ---
# (Keeping the median split logic for Age and Pack Years)
pid_final_df <- pid_final_df %>% 
  mutate(
    outcome_label = factor(outcome, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Low-grade", "High-grade")),
    age_group = ifelse(age_mean > median(age_mean, na.rm=T), "Age > Median", "Age < Median"),
    py_group = ifelse(pack_years_mean > median(pack_years_mean, na.rm=T), "PY > Median", "PY < Median")
  )

treg_mva_asc <- treg_mva_asc %>% 
  mutate(
    outcome_label = factor(outcome, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Healthy", "NSCLC")),
    age_group = ifelse(Age > median(Age, na.rm=T), "Old", "Young")
  )

# --- 3B. Revised Universal Plotting Function ---
make_covariate_plot <- function(df, x_var, color_var, title, point_colors) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = treg_39_mg)) +
    # Neutral boxplots to keep focus on the colored dots
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "gray95", color = "gray30", width = 0.6) +
    # Dots colored by clinical outcome (Grade or NSCLC status)
    geom_jitter(aes(color = .data[[color_var]]), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
    # Wilcoxon test comparing the two categories on the X-axis
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", 
                       label = "p.format", 
                       label.x = 1.5,
                       size = 5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = point_colors) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = treg_lab, color = "Status") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = "black", face = "bold"))
}

# --- 3C. Define Palettes & Generate Plots ---
# UCLH Palette
pid_pts <- c("Low-grade" = "gray60", "High-grade" = "gold")
p1 <- make_covariate_plot(pid_final_df, "age_group", "outcome_label", "UCLH: Age", pid_pts)
p2 <- make_covariate_plot(pid_final_df, "py_group", "outcome_label", "UCLH: Pack Years", pid_pts)
p3 <- make_covariate_plot(pid_final_df, "Sex_L4L", "outcome_label", "UCLH: Sex", pid_pts)
p4 <- make_covariate_plot(pid_final_df, "cancer_before_any", "outcome_label", "UCLH: Prior Ca", pid_pts)

# ASCENT Palette
asc_pts <- c("Healthy" = "gray60", "NSCLC" = "dodgerblue3")
p5 <- make_covariate_plot(treg_mva_asc, "age_group", "outcome_label", "ASCENT: Age", asc_pts)
p6 <- make_covariate_plot(treg_mva_asc, "Gender", "outcome_label", "ASCENT: Sex", asc_pts)
p7 <- make_covariate_plot(treg_mva_asc, "smoking_binary", "outcome_label", "ASCENT: Smoking", asc_pts)

# --- 3D. Final Assembly ---
pid_row <- ggpubr::ggarrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 4, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "right")
ascent_row <- ggpubr::ggarrange(p5, p6, p7, ncol = 3, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "right")

final_panel <- ggpubr::ggarrange(pid_row, ascent_row, nrow = 2)
print(final_panel)

# Save PID forest plot
ggsave(filename = "/Users/Petros/Downloads/pid_forest_plot.pdf", 
       plot = pid_forest_plot, 
       width = 12, height = 8, device = "pdf")

# Save ASCENT forest plot
ggsave(filename = "/Users/Petros/Downloads/asc_forest_plot.pdf", 
       plot = asc_forest_plot, 
       width = 12, height = 8, device = "pdf")
```
